newsitem.title: USA: Avid Tech expects charge, resulting in loss.
newsitem.headline: Avid Tech expects charge, resulting in loss.

text.p: Avid Technology Inc said on Friday that it expects results for the third quarter 1996 to include one-time charges of about $9 million and expects to report a loss for the quarter of about $0.32 to $0.37 a share.
In a release on Friday, the company said the charges were related to its decision not to release the Avid Media Spectrum product line.
Excluding the one-time charges, the company said it expects to report a loss in the range of $0.04 to $0.09 a share.
hat it expects to report revenues of about $115 million for the quarter and that it plans to release financial results on Thursday, October 24, 1996.
